goals.name: Code Debug Session Goal Harness
goals.description: Code Debug Session Goal Harness [code-debug-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hA-04-code-debug.yaml
goals.gate: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and the bug pinned to an exact symptom
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and the bug pinned to an exact symptom statement: observed behavior, expected behavior, environment
gates.command: Session log contains the three-part symptom statement verbatim

gates.name: 0.2 Procedures declared mandatory: reproduce first, one hypothes
gates.description: Procedures declared mandatory: reproduce first, one hypothesis at a time, evidence kills hypotheses, fix lands with a regression test
gates.command: All four procedure names in session preamble

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before the first investigation command
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before the first investigation command
gates.command: Session log line 'COORD: L1-L4 x D1-D2 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_debug(repro, hypothesis_ladder, root_cause,
gates.description: Harness tuple H_debug(repro, hypothesis_ladder, root_cause, regression_lock, improvement) declared
gates.command: Tuple declaration present in session log

gates.name: 1.1 Deterministic repro captured: a minimal command, script, or
gates.description: Deterministic repro captured: a minimal command, script, or test that triggers the bug on the current tree, with its failure output recorded
gates.command: .rig/debug/repro.txt contains the exact repro command and its failing output tail; repro re-run confirmed within the session

gates.name: 1.2 Environment facts captured: OS/arch, runtime versions (node
gates.description: Environment facts captured: OS/arch, runtime versions (node --version / python -V / go version), dependency lockfile hash, and relevant env flags recorded before theorizing
gates.command: .rig/debug/env.txt with version outputs and shasum of lockfile (shasum -a 256 package-lock.json | poetry.lock | go.sum)

gates.name: 1.3 Recency check: git log on the implicated files plus (if avai
gates.description: Recency check: git log on the implicated files plus (if available) git bisect or a last-known-good claim verified by running the repro against that commit
gates.command: git log --oneline -20 -- <files> output in .rig/debug/history.txt; bisect log or 'no known good' statement recorded

gates.name: 2.1 Hypothesis ladder written before the first code change: at l
gates.description: Hypothesis ladder written before the first code change: at least 2 competing hypotheses, each with the cheapest experiment that would kill it
gates.command: .rig/debug/hypotheses.md with numbered hypotheses and kill-experiments; single-hypothesis sessions explicitly justified

gates.name: 2.2 One variable at a time: each experiment changes exactly one
gates.description: One variable at a time: each experiment changes exactly one thing (one instrumentation point, one config flip, one binary-search halving); the session log records per-experiment results
gates.command: hypotheses.md updated per experiment with 'result: confirmed/killed + evidence'

gates.name: 2.3 Instrumentation is temporary: added logging/debug prints are
gates.description: Instrumentation is temporary: added logging/debug prints are confined to a named branch or clearly marked and are removed before closure
gates.command: Final git diff contains zero leftover debug statements — grep -nE '(console\.log|print\(|dbg!|println!)' over the fix diff returns only intentional logging with justification

gates.name: 3.1 Root cause stated in causal form: 'X happens because Y', whe
gates.description: Root cause stated in causal form: 'X happens because Y', where Y is a mechanism in the code/runtime — not 'the fix works' or 'the value was wrong'
gates.command: .rig/debug/root-cause.md contains the causal sentence plus the file:line of the mechanism

gates.name: 3.2 Fix targets the cause, not the symptom: the diff modifies th
gates.description: Fix targets the cause, not the symptom: the diff modifies the causal mechanism, and the session log explicitly rules out symptom-suppression (no catch-and-swallow, no special-casing the repro input, no broadened timeout)
gates.command: root-cause.md 'symptom-check' section answers all three suppression patterns with evidence from the diff

gates.name: 3.3 Repro now passes: the exact repro command from gate 1.1 re-r
gates.description: Repro now passes: the exact repro command from gate 1.1 re-run against the fixed tree exits 0 / produces expected behavior
gates.command: .rig/debug/repro-fixed.txt with the same command and its clean output, stamped with the fixed HEAD SHA

gates.name: 4.1 Regression test committed: a test that fails on the pre-fix
gates.description: Regression test committed: a test that fails on the pre-fix tree and passes on the post-fix tree (red-then-green proven, not assumed)
gates.command: .rig/debug/regression-proof.txt with the test failure output at pre-fix SHA and pass output at post-fix SHA

gates.name: 4.2 Blast-radius check: full test suite plus typecheck/lint run
gates.description: Blast-radius check: full test suite plus typecheck/lint run on the fixed tree; neighboring behaviors sharing the fixed mechanism are exercised (or the risk is logged)
gates.command: Exit codes in .rig/debug/final-green.txt; risk note if shared-mechanism paths lack tests

gates.name: 4.3 Improvement entry written: the detection gap that let this b
gates.description: Improvement entry written: the detection gap that let this bug through (missing test, missing alert, missing invariant) is named
gates.command: Appended line to ~/.hermes/jake/improvements.log tagged hA-04-code-debug with the named gap

preconditions.startup_phrase: No fix without root cause. No root cause without reproduction.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for reproduction and verification; A2 for instrumentation edits; A3 for log reading only; A4 forbidden

self_improvement.update_trigger: same detection gap appears 3+ times → propose an invariant, assertion, or monitoring check to close the class

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates
root-cause.md contains a mechanism-level causal statement
Repro passes on the fixed tree; regression test committed with red-then-green proof
Full suite green on the fixed tree
One improvement entry naming the detection gap
Identity closure: coordinate, root cause in one line, next safe action stated
failure_states: if root cause remains unreachable after the hypothesis ladder is exhausted, halt and escalate with the full evidence trail — never ship a speculative fix as a fix
halt gate(s) 1.1, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3: no progress without gate evidence
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and the bug pinned to an exact symptom statement: observed behavior, expected behavior, environment
Procedures declared mandatory: reproduce first, one hypothesis at a time, evidence kills hypotheses, fix lands with a regression test
RIG coordinate stated before the first investigation command
Harness tuple H_debug(repro, hypothesis_ladder, root_cause, regression_lock, improvement) declared
Deterministic repro captured: a minimal command, script, or test that triggers the bug on the current tree, with its failure output recorded
Environment facts captured: OS/arch, runtime versions (node --version / python -V / go version), dependency lockfile hash, and relevant env flags recorded before theorizing
Recency check: git log on the implicated files plus (if available) git bisect or a last-known-good claim verified by running the repro against that commit
Hypothesis ladder written before the first code change: at least 2 competing hypotheses, each with the cheapest experiment that would kill it
One variable at a time: each experiment changes exactly one thing (one instrumentation point, one config flip, one binary-search halving); the session log records per-experiment results
Instrumentation is temporary: added logging/debug prints are confined to a named branch or clearly marked and are removed before closure
Root cause stated in causal form: 'X happens because Y', where Y is a mechanism in the code/runtime — not 'the fix works' or 'the value was wrong'

Fix targets the cause, not the symptom: the diff modifies the causal mechanism, and the session log explicitly rules out symptom-suppression (no catch-and-swallow, no special-casing the repro input, no broadened timeout)
Repro now passes: the exact repro command from gate 1.1 re-run against the fixed tree exits 0 / produces expected behavior
Regression test committed: a test that fails on the pre-fix tree and passes on the post-fix tree (red-then-green proven, not assumed)
Blast-radius check: full test suite plus typecheck/lint run on the fixed tree; neighboring behaviors sharing the fixed mechanism are exercised (or the risk is logged)
Improvement entry written: the detection gap that let this bug through (missing test, missing alert, missing invariant) is named

final_rule: No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every code-debug session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

failure_protocol.notes: if root cause remains unreachable after the hypothesis ladder is exhausted, halt and escalate with the full evidence trail — never ship a speculative fix as a fix
